title: It's 1,265 m Tall and Has Four Steep Sides #shorts
description:
In 2016, a four-sided peak in Antarctica's Ellsworth Mountains went viral. Some said a lost civilization built it, others said aliens. But water gets into cracks, freezes and expands, and over hundreds of millions of years that can carve sharp faces. As geologist Eric Rignot told Live Science: it's just a mountain that looks like a pyramid. Verdict: solved.

Five more Antarctic mysteries are in the full video on the channel.

3D scenes are illustrations. Sources: Live Science, "New Pyramid in Antarctica? Not Quite, Say Geologists"; Live Science, "Antarctica 'pyramid'..."
